Monza — Autodromo Nazionale (Italy)

Italian GP · theme green · day circuit (night:false) · survey branch cursor/monza-survey-a1 @ 6dff3bc (incl. daytime-rain lighting merge PR #1979) · read-only survey, 72 frames, TLX/SwiftShader

Summary

  • Verdicts: verify-track OK; audit-circuit all six checks OK within baselines (float 0, clip 9 severe = baseline 9, coplanar 3 = 3, ground buried 0 / unsupported 0 / flatCoplanar 4, props 304 163 tris). Baselines were not touched.
  • Geometry: built lap 5777.16 m (def lengthKm 5.8, OSM path.len 5787, real ≈ 5.793 km [from memory, not fetched this session]): −0.28 % vs real. Sector splits and 11 turn anchors match the FIA offsets quoted in the circuit def.
  • Visuals: 72 frames, 0 capture failures. Day weathers respond correctly after the daytime-rain lighting merge (PR #1979). Worst visible problems: a leaning cream board at Parabolica in every frame at frac 0.83; night foliage stays bright green; fog never touches the sky; a monolithic red stand at Parabolica; rain and storm nearly identical.

Night / lamps

The def has night:false and furniture.lamp:"none"; scenery adds only ~28 pit-straight pole pairs and 5 corner poles (L340–355, L667–680), all plain dark boxes with a pale head box, no light source. Per the survey-track skill, night race lighting is authored only for the seven night:true circuits; Monza accepts the night tod for sky/fog but has no night scenery. "Lit window bands" (L229–236, 510–516, 627–634) are flat-coloured boxes — they do not read as emissive.

Brief / real-world cross-check

  • docs/tracks/monza.md cites two FIA previews (2024 gravel strips: https://www.fia.com/news/f1-2024-italian-grand-prix-preview; 2025 sector lines: https://www.fia.com/news/f1-2025-italian-grand-prix-preview). Not re-fetched this session; the in-code sector arithmetic matches (see above).
  • The brief's own caveat: the Sopraelevata crossing is at Serraglio between the Lesmos and Ascari (≈ lap frac 0.55–0.60), but the flyover overheadSpan sits at 0.73 (between Ascari and Parabolica) and its trees are cleared 0.685–0.775 — a probable misplacement, unverified against a map.
  • Real-world fact estimates (5.793 km, 11 turns) are from memory; width, banking angles and gravel extents are flagged as estimates in the def itself (L375–376, L389–390).

Not captured / uncertain

  • Cut from the plan: eye and trackside only at day-dry (12 frames) — no eye/trackside for wet/rain/storm/fog/dusk/night; no aerial/map view; no 'park' (chase) view; no dawn.
  • Gallery filename: I used monza-<nn>-<view>-p<i>-<tod>-<weather>.png because build-gallery.cjs parses the tail as tod-condition; the requested weather-then-tod order would mis-parse. storm is not in its WEATHER_TAIL list, so storm frames may show as tod 'unknown' (see gallery result).
  • Flyover, banking and stand real-world positions, widths and the 5.793 km figure are unverified (no web fetch this session; FIA URLs come from the brief).
  • The tilt mechanism of the Parabolica board and the origin of the tan verge bands are inferred from code + frames, not isolated by experiment.
  • Pixel evidence is TLX on SwiftShader only (no GPU, no GLX/WGX comparison).
